answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The dune edge is entered both ways, so a closed ring of 119 clones produces a signature the anchor analysis flags immediately. Anyone must as a result build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the ledge settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 37 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
